biotools.summary: gMISpy is a Python package designed to compute genetic Minimal Intervention Sets (gMISs) by integrating complex metabolic and regulatory networks. It allows for advanced biological modeling by incorporating cyclic regulatory logic to improve predictions for genetic interventions.
